mealPlan.name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Asparagus and Lemon Quinoa
instructions: Rinse quinoa thoroughly. In a small saucepan, combine 1 cup dry quinoa with 2 cups water (or vegetable broth) and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until water is absorbed. Let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
On a large baking sheet, toss trimmed asparagus spears with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread them in a single layer.

Pat salmon fillets dry. Place them on the same baking sheet (or a separate one lined with parchment paper). Drizzle salmon with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Season with garlic powder, dried dill (if using), salt, and pepper. Top with lemon slices.
Bake salmon and asparagus for 12-18 minutes, or until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork, and asparagus is tender-crisp. Cooking time will depend on the thickness of the salmon.
Serve baked salmon and roasted asparagus alongside the fluffy quinoa. Garnish with fresh lemon wedges if desired.
tips: For extra flavor, marinate salmon in a mix of olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs for 15-30 minutes before baking.
You can substitute other vegetables like broccoli or bell peppers for asparagus.
Ensure your quinoa is thoroughly rinsed to remove saponins, which can cause a bitter taste.
